description: The bar chart illustrates the model evaluation on various academic and professional datasets and metrics, comparing the performance of two models, labeled as "Leaderboard" and "Ours (Iterative)". The horizontal axis represents the different datasets and metrics, listed in a specific order, while the vertical axis is labeled "Score (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each group consisting of two bars representing the two models, colored blue for "Leaderboard" and orange for "Ours (Iterative)". The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and the datasets and metrics are listed as GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with scores ranging from approximately 70% to 85% for GSM-8K, around 78% for MMLU, 70% and 84% for HumanEval, 86% and 88% for TruthfulQA, 90% for ARC, 70% and 80% for MBPP, 70% and 80% for LC AlpacaEval-2, 88% for MT Bench (×5), and 78% and 80% for Chat-Arena-Hard. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bars.
